sg-3-2-3-0.title: The Sea-Green Parapet
sg-3-2-3-0.text: Jagged splinters spit from the masonry as a heavy icicle of fused quartz shears off the high cornice, shattering against your heels with a sharp ring of displaced air. You cling to the crumbling parapet of sea-green glass, watching bright dust drift down into the sun-bleached chasm below while your embers shift lazily in their iron cage.
exits: Trace the perimeter along the towering glass barrier
Ascend the winding ramp toward the broader flats
